name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. domain=ui (UI/menu read-only table in uitab.c, used by class-promotion church menu). Descriptor reflects data type (table), index semantics (per basic portrait id = the early-game character in basic-class form, 0..0x11), and content (class-change key item id). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching 0x526a7 or any data addr). All trailing tokens are semantic domain terms, not address fragments.
purpose: Per-basic-class class-change key-item id lookup: maps each early-game character (by runtime_char.bPortrait_id, 0..0x11) to the inventory item that unlocks that character's alternate (special) promotion path in the church class-promotion menu.
logic_summary: const byte[18] indexed by runtime_char.bPortrait_id. Two readers MOVZX a single byte: (1) fd2_build_promotion_candidates_with_targets @0x3180A passes table[portrait_id] to fd2_find_inventory_slot_with_item; if the member carries that item the target class is bumped from default portrait_id+0x20 to alt portrait_id+0x32. (2) fd2_run_class_promotion_menu_main @0x31525 reads table[bPortrait_id] as the item to consume when the chosen class_id > 0x31 (alt path). 0xFF = no alt item. Index 7 (蘭斯洛特) is never read because the candidate loop skips portrait_id==7. Separately, portrait 9 (悠妮) has a hard-coded extra path: carrying Sword 0x5A unlocks class 0x34.
element_semantics: table[bPortrait_id] = item id of the class-change ('轉職') key item for that basic-class character. Verified against fd2-knowledge item table -- every non-0xFF value is a real promotion item: 0x58 聖者之戒 (priest/mage->saint), 0x59 勇者徽章 (Sol->hero), 0x5B 領悟之書 (monk->martial-saint), 0x5C 心眼之書 (archer->sniper), 0x5D 白金徽章 (soldier->magic-warrior), 0xCD 飛龍卵 (knight->dragon-knight; the three knight chars 亞雷斯/洛娜/萊汀 at idx 4,5,6). 0xFF at idx 2,16,17 = no table-driven alt item. Index 7 unread.
comment_original_issue: Original src comment claimed the 0xCD bytes at indices 4..7 are 'unused filler', justified only by portrait_id 7 being skipped. That is substantively wrong: 0xCD is a real item id (飛龍卵, the knight->dragon-knight class-change item) and is meaningful for the three knight characters at indices 4,5,6 (亞雷斯/洛娜/萊汀), which ARE read by the candidate loop. Only index 7 (蘭斯洛特) is genuinely never read. The comment also lacked the verified per-value item meanings.
